shared_elements: single standing anthropomorphic figure filling the field
elaborate headdress / head ornament above the face
circular disc or pectoral ornament on the chest
banded belt / girdle at the waist
arms brought in front of the body
incised ornamental detail on the torso
justification: Both depict a single frontal anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole field with a headdress/head ornament above, a circular disc-like pectoral centred on the chest, banded girdle at the waist and arms brought in toward the belly, which is a moderately specific shared scheme. But A is a densely detailed, richly costumed figure with a profile head, plumes, hanging feather-like panels and a staff held at the side, while B is a blocky schematic body with only a few shallow relief motifs and no held object, so the manner of depiction and the level of iconographic elaboration differ sharply.
